rules: Red Player card for Utopia. Port: the compass has an anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face. State side A is the unchanged player-card back.
Companion Informant is played, not kept in hand for a passive bonus. It moves up to 4 Utopia Infection cards from the Infection discard into the Game End area.
notes: Card id 10702. Scratch state card id 10703.
Printed code P8-03b stays on the scratched face.
Coordinates are printed 41°45'10"N 111°31'60"E. The longitude seconds are printed 60.
This is the only Utopia Player card. The recon report puts it in the Player discard pile.
No bullseye sticker circle is printed. The Utopia Infection cards say Utopia cannot be improved. This Player card does not say that.
